scheme_name: CM’s Lairik Heiminnashi Programme (CMLH): Pre-Matric Remedial Coaching
description:
The CM’s Lairik Heiminnashi Programme (CMLH) is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Manipur. 

It was launched on October 31, 2021. 

The program aims to provide remedial coaching to students from economically weaker sections. 

This initiative specifically targets students who are enrolled in classes IX and X. 

The primary objective of the CMLH is to improve the academic performance of these students. 

The scheme aims to enhance their chances of success in board examinations. 

The program also seeks to reduce the dropout rates among students from marginalized communities. 

The CMLH focuses on providing quality education and support to underprivileged students. 

The scheme is designed to bridge the educational gap faced by these students. 

The government has set a measurable target of enrolling at least 5,000 students annually. 

The program is expected to provide coaching in subjects such as Mathematics, Science, and English. 

Each student enrolled in the program will receive free coaching classes. 

The coaching will be conducted by qualified teachers. 

The program will also provide study materials free of cost. 

Students will receive additional support through mentorship programs. 

The eligibility criteria for the CMLH are specific and well-defined. 

Students must belong to economically weaker sections of society. 

The annual family income should not exceed INR 2.5 lakh. 

Students must be currently enrolled in classes IX or X in government or government-aided schools. 

There are no specific educational qualifications required beyond being in the appropriate class. 

The application process for the CMLH is straightforward. 

Interested students must obtain the application form from their respective schools. 

The form can also be downloaded from the official website of the Education Department of Manipur. 

Completed application forms must be submitted to the school authorities. 

Students are required to attach a copy of their income certificate. 

They must also provide proof of their enrollment in classes IX or X. 

The application deadline is typically set at the beginning of the academic year. 

Students are encouraged to apply as early as possible to secure their place in the program. 

The coaching classes under the CMLH are conducted throughout the academic year. 

Classes are usually held on weekends and during school holidays. 

The frequency of classes is designed to ensure that students receive ample support. 

Disbursement of study materials occurs at the beginning of each term. 

The Education Department of Manipur is the implementing authority for this program. 

They are responsible for overseeing the execution of the CMLH. 

The department also monitors the quality of coaching provided. 

Contact details for the Education Department can be found on their official website. 

The CMLH is part of a broader initiative to enhance educational outcomes in Manipur. 

The state government has allocated a budget of INR 10 crore for the implementation of this scheme. 

This funding is aimed at ensuring that all necessary resources are available for the program. 

The CMLH is expected to significantly impact the educational landscape in Manipur. 

It aims to empower students from disadvantaged backgrounds. 

By providing quality education, the program seeks to foster a sense of confidence among students. 

The CMLH also aligns with the national goals of improving literacy rates. 

It contributes to the overall development of the state by nurturing young talent. 

The program is a step towards achieving educational equity in Manipur. 

The government is committed to monitoring the progress of enrolled students. 

Regular assessments will be conducted to evaluate their academic performance. 

Feedback from students and teachers will be collected to improve the program. 

The CMLH is a crucial initiative in the context of the socio-economic challenges faced by many families in Manipur. 

It addresses the barriers to education that many students encounter. 

The scheme is expected to create a supportive learning environment. 

This environment will encourage students to excel academically. 

The CMLH is an example of targeted intervention in the education sector. 

It reflects the government’s commitment to inclusive education. 

The program is designed to be sustainable and impactful in the long term. 

By focusing on remedial coaching, it aims to uplift the educational standards of the state. 

The CMLH is a vital resource for students who require additional support. 

It provides them with the tools necessary to succeed in their academic endeavors. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's dedication to fostering education for all. 

Through this program, the government hopes to create a brighter future for the youth of Manipur. 

The CMLH is not just a welfare scheme; it is a pathway to empowerment. 

It aims to transform the lives of students by providing them with opportunities. 

The program is an essential step towards building a knowledgeable and skilled workforce. 

The CMLH is a significant move towards achieving educational justice in the region. 

It is a proactive approach to addressing the needs of underprivileged students. 

The government encourages community involvement in supporting this initiative. 

Local stakeholders are invited to participate in the program's implementation. 

The CMLH is a model for similar initiatives across other states in India. 

It showcases the importance of targeted educational support for marginalized groups. 

The program is expected to yield positive results in the coming years. 

The government remains committed to refining and expanding the CMLH. 

Through continuous evaluation and feedback, the program aims to adapt to changing needs. 

The CMLH represents a significant investment in the future of Manipur's youth. 

It is a clear indication of the importance placed on education by the state government. 

The program is a vital component of the broader educational reforms being undertaken in Manipur. 

The CMLH is poised to make a lasting impact on the lives of many students. 

It embodies the spirit of hope and opportunity for the youth of the state.
